basic_details.job_title: IIT Ropar Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for Junior Research Fellow / Project Assistant Posts
basic_details.short_information: Applications have been invited from Indian nationals for the position of Junior Research Fellow (JRF) or Project Assistant to work in the ANRF-PAIR sponsored project titled “Dynamic research ecosystem for advanced materials (DREAMS)” with a focus on sustainable energy conversion/storage system (electrocatalysis/batteries) at the Indian Institute of Technology Ropar. Candidates can apply by email or post to the undersigned by 20/11/2026.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess a First Class (6.5 grades point out of 10) or 60% marks (55% marks for SC/ST) in Master or equivalent degree in Chemistry/ Materials Science, with qualified NET or GATE for JRF. Candidates without NET/GATE qualifications may be considered for project assistant position.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The emoluments for the position are As per ANRF rules. The duration of the position is 3.0 years or till the completion of the project, whichever is earlier. The position is purely temporary and performance will be reviewed periodically.
